title: RBI Cancellation of NBFC Certificates of Registration – September 2026
description: <cite index="79-1,79-2">Eight Non-Banking Financial Companies have surrendered their Certificates of Registration and exited the NBFC business, with cancellations effected under the RBI Act, 1934</cite>. <cite index="79-8,79-9,79-10,79-11,79-12">Additionally, RBI cancelled the CoR of five NBFCs under Section 45-IA(6) including Dar's Financial Services Pvt. Ltd., Rolta Holding and Finance Corporation Private Limited, Vasudeo Securities Pvt. Ltd., Parsoli Corporation Limited and A. C. Choksi Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. (now Deus Financial Capital Private Limited)</cite>.
